correctness.rationale: The four-share normalization is an exact identity on the full stated parameter ranges. The minimax theorem follows from compactness/continuity and a two-sided bound: every point has objective at least \(\max\{m_1,m_2\}\), while a pair of individual minimizers attains it. The boundary comparison is set inclusion. Exact rational arithmetic verifies that the reported Wuhan conditional first coordinates sum to 1.4399 while the hierarchical shares sum to one. Scope is restricted to the instantaneous printed algebra and fixed \(\sigma\).

value.rationale: This is not a cosmetic renaming: the extra simplex removes valid hierarchical allocations and the boundary reduction can raise the stated instantaneous objective. The correction replaces a constrained two-dimensional/boundary search by an exact separable minimax law and explains why the paper's own practical within-group ratios are incompatible with its stated feasible set. This directly affects the interpretation and implementation of the resource-allocation rule.
